findings.title: The Lasts column mixes days and weeks

location.description: The table in the hero panel, right-hand column.

findings.viewer_experience: A volunteer comparing stock cannot compare 4 days with 2 weeks at a glance, so the row that runs short soonest does not stand out except through its red colour.

current.value: Values such as 3 weeks, 2 weeks, 4 days and 9 days in one column.

findings.target: All values in the column use one unit, so they can be compared by eye.
findings.fix_direction: Use one unit for every row, or sort the rows so the shortest comes first.

closed_when.check: Looking at the column, every value uses the same unit or the rows run from shortest to longest.

findings.title: The short-stock row is marked by colour alone

location.description: The Baby formula row in the hero panel.

findings.viewer_experience: A viewer who cannot tell red from brown sees a row like the others. The warning is lost for them.

current.value: The row differs from the others only in its text colour.

findings.target: The row is marked in a way that does not depend on colour.
findings.fix_direction: Add a word, a symbol or a change in weight to the flagged row.

closed_when.check: Looking at the table, the flagged row differs from the others by more than its colour.
